links.comparator_used: Training on all available slices without excluding artifact-affected DWI slices (vCE-all)
links.outcome: Whole-image SSIM, lesion-based metrics, and reader ratings of lesion enhancement and image quality for virtual contrast-enhanced breast MRI
links.effect: Excluding artifact slices raised whole-image SSIM slightly (vCE-all 0.843 ± 0.034; vCE-clean 0.849 ± 0.031, p < 0.001, d_av = 0.20). Lesion-based metrics and qualitative ratings were comparable between models. At inference, strong low-intensity DWI artifacts were associated with higher lesion-based errors.
links.quote: However, lesion-based metrics and qualitative ratings of lesion enhancement and image quality were comparable between models.

design_hint: image quality control (artifact exclusion in training and artifact screening at inference)
